svg.title: Set up Quartz
svg.desc: The production Publish to the web panel with Quartz chosen, on a Mac, after Create note was pressed in the scene. Step 1, Create the note, has an Open note button and, under a hairline, a line asking to read the note, then a line saying to publish it too with a plugin that publishes only chosen notes. Step 2, Install the Quartz plugin, asks which Quartz the site is, set to Quartz 5, then has a Reveal in Finder button and, under a hairline, a line for each smaller step: open a terminal in the site's folder; run the command that adds the plugin, in a well with a Copy button at its end; commit and push quartz.config.yaml and quartz.lock.json. Step 3, All done, is below the picture's edge.
